calls.prompt:
Create one horizontal animation strip for Codex pet `rita-rossweisse`, state `idle`.

Input image roles:
1. Classic maid identity reference: use only for short-haired Rita's face/identity/outfit cues. Ignore the weapon and all scene content.
2. Layout guide: spacing-only invisible guide for six equal slots, centered full-body poses and padding. Do NOT render the guide.
3. Canonical base: exact approved identity and costume reference; preserve its proportions, face, markings, palette and materials.

Output exactly SIX complete, separated full-body poses in one left-to-right horizontal row on a perfectly flat pure #00FF00 background. Six equally sized invisible slots, one centered complete figure per slot, even spacing, no overlap, clipping, empty slots, labels or borders. Same apparent anatomical scale and stable baseline, modest safe padding.

Polished clean 2D anime chibi sticker illustration, restrained cel shading and crisp dark outlines, about 2.6 heads tall with mature poised demeanor. Preserve exact Rita identity: short ash-brown bob, side-swept bangs naturally covering anatomical LEFT eye (front screen-right), and her visible anatomical RIGHT wine-red eye (front screen-left) comfortably open in all six frames. Never reveal or invent the hidden eye; no blink, wink or half-closed eye. White frilled maid headband, black side bows, small wine-red rose on her anatomical RIGHT temple (front screen-left). Classic black-and-white combat maid outfit only: white puff sleeves, fitted black bodice, white waist apron and short white-frilled skirt, dark long gloves, dark thigh-high stockings and black low-heel shoes. Both hands empty. Preserve asymmetry and do not mirror her.

Quiet resting idle loop with subtly distinct breathing phases, never effectively static copies: (1) neutral poised stance, (2) small inhale, (3) soft chest lift and minute head tilt, (4) exhale, (5) skirt and hair gently settle, (6) return very close to neutral. Only small calm changes in breathing, head/hair/cloth; feet planted and pleasant small smile. Keep pose, facing, silhouette, costume, face, colors and scale consistent. First and last frames visually very close.

No scythe, weapons, cup, flowers in hands, tools, props, scene, text, guide marks, checkerboard, shadows, floor shadow, aura, effects, glows, motion blur, speed lines, dust, detached ornaments, stray pixels, or green/chroma-key pixels inside the character.
